class.name: EditorForm
class.experimental: This editor UI component may change as more editor screens adopt it.
class.brief_description: A standardized section container for editor forms.
class.description: Use [EditorForm] for dialogs and tools that are not directly editing an [Object] through [EditorInspector]. It standardizes section spacing while leaving data binding and mutation to the owning screen.

method.name: add_section
method.description: Creates and adds a form section with the given title.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all sections and their controls.
